profile.headline: Backend API Developer
profile.summary:
I have been practicing in the field of full stack software development for the past six years predominantly in the real estate industry. I have expertise in REST APIs and the development of Web/Mobile (Android & iOS) apps and Databases. I have a problem-solving mindset and am a strategic thinker who is self-motivated to continually improve myself. I am passionate about creating applications and platforms that improve user experience by building a reliable and robust backend. I am seeking a new challenge to expand on my current skillset and broaden my understanding of the field. 

Languages:          Java, C#, Swift, ObjectiveC, C/C++(Novice), Clojure(Novice), ClojureScript(Novice)
Database:             TSQL, PL/SQL, ORDBMS, Oracle 11g, SQLite
Tools:                    Android Studio, Eclipse, Xcode, Visual Studio, Visual Studio Code, Mac OS, Windows OS, Slack
Skills:                    Android app development(Java/Kotlin), iOS app development(ObjectiveC/Swift), Web development with C# .net and Classic ASP
Source Control:   Git/GitHub, TFS, SVN
Others:                  OO design patterns, Algorithms, Analytical Skills, Quantitative Research, Quality Assurance

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
As a backend-focused .NET developer with expertise in AWS and infrastructure-as-code using Terraform, I specialize in building scalable, secure, and cleanly architected APIs that power frontend and BFF (Backend-for-Frontend) applications. My role centers around transforming raw data into well-structured, high-performance service layers that BFF developers rely on to build responsive and modular UI backends.

I collaborate closely with platform and UI teams, ensuring APIs are flexible, consistent, and easy to consume. I take pride in designing systems that promote maintainability and long-term clarity — applying clean code principles, domain-driven design thinking, and continuous improvement in every iteration.

Whether it’s modeling API contracts, optimizing service performance, or provisioning cloud resources with Terraform, I bring a thoughtful, system-oriented approach to every challenge.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
- Solely responsible for maintenance and updates of existing customer apps as well as their release to Play store.
- Development of Walking Farm and LiveMaps using Google Maps API (Mobile and Web). Which consists of data manipulation, drawing tools, map gesturing, shape (polygon and polyline) drawing, custom-made marker plotting, and overlays listening events by user input.
- Development of MovieStudio on Android which includes features like concatenating multiple videos (from server or device), adding start/end bumpers with custom text/image, merging audio and final video, and sharing on the company’s “mySpace” or social medial sites (Youtube, FaceBook, Instagram, etc).
- Designed, developed, and maintained REST APIs (Classic ASP and C# .net) which were consumed by mobile and web applications. API supports multiple formats (JSON and XML)
Integrated with external data vendors’ API to get, manipulate and display the data at user's requests on Google Maps, ListViews, and chartView.
- Designed, developed, tested, and published the inventory app as the sole developer using external data vendor’s APIs.
- Developed MediaLib on Android which includes features like file manager, downloading and uploading files to/from the server. 
- Designed, developed, and maintained API backend using MSSQL - DB design, stored procedures, views, DB maintenance, and reporting. 
- Used Postman to unit test and manipulate all the API that has been used on regular bases.

positions.title: Network Administrator
positions.description:
• Routine in-house network administrative jobs
• Design and implementation of data/system backups for multiple clients.
• Running monthly test backup/restore for data integrity 
• Design, edit and update the infrastructure documentation using MS Visio.
• Design and implementation ESX3i virtualized network – managing 5 virtual servers on VMware vSphere with Thecus Rackmount NAS box as external data storage. The whole network was created with redundancy ESXi3 and data storage. 
• Assisting the senior network engineer with design, implementation and troubleshooting of Cisco routers and hardware firewall; windows based LAN and WAN using WireShark & Fiddler. 
• Design and implementation of network with Satellite modem and Cisco887 router with Microsoft Windows Server 2008 SBS (main domain controller with 6 Automation workstations). Also designed, implemented and troubleshoot remote access for office staff. 
• Design, implementation and troubleshooting of remote access – Windows VPN, Cisco VPN and Shrew soft VPN
• Network/Desktop support - in person/telephone support/remote assistant 
• Design and implementation of wireless router using Cisco, Linksys and Netgear devices
• Design and implementation of 3G wireless router using NetComm790 and Westermo MRD330.
• Design and implementation of NetGear ReadyNAS and Thecus Rackmount NAS boxes for multiple clients. It was design for daily data traffic using dual network card, iSCSI and SNMP for UPS support. 
• R&D for new software or hardware for computer networks, Automation technologies, in-House project management, in-House accounting packages, visual effects for multiple clients. 
• Conducting Annual maintenance task for client – cleaning and replacing hardware, updating and upgrading software, power cycling servers, network switches, routers and firewalls. 
• Working with Microsoft, HP, Dell & Cisco for real production issues on client side.

positions.title: Engineering Trainee
positions.description:
Summer Trainee for three month during school holidays
• Assisting the system engineers with installations of new machines.
• Assisting the network administrators with Imaging and Ghosting of workstations.
• Labeling and documenting the hardware for asset management.  
• Updating the infrastructure documentation using MS Visio.
• Monitoring daily data backup using in-house backup system. 
• Various other administrative jobs.
• Editing MS office documentation
